mapper.select: select , ts_rank_cd(public.etd_knowledge_to_tsvector(c.content), public.etd_knowledge_to_tsquery(#{query})) as keyword_score from ai_knowledge_chunk c join ai_knowledge_document d on d.id = c.document_id and d.knowledge_base_id = c.knowledge_base_id join ai_knowledge_base b on b.id = d.knowledge_base_id where and public.etd_knowledge_to_tsvector(c.content) @@ public.etd_knowledge_to_tsquery(#{query}) order by keyword_score desc, c.id limit #{base.keywordRecallSize}

select c.id as chunk_id, d.id as document_id, c.content, d.processing_version from ai_knowledge_chunk c join ai_knowledge_document d on d.id = c.document_id and d.knowledge_base_id = c.knowledge_base_id where d.knowledge_base_id = #{base.id} and d.del_flag = 0 and c.del_flag = 0 and d.chunk_status = 'confirmed' and d.upload_status = 'completed' order by d.id, c.chunk_index
mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (id, content, metadata, vector) values (#{id}, #{content}, cast(#{metadata} as jsonb), cast(#{vector} as vector)) on conflict (knowledge_base_id, index_version, chunk_id, processing_version) do nothing
mapper.select: select count(*) from ai_knowledge_chunk c join ai_knowledge_document d on d.id = c.document_id and d.knowledge_base_id = c.knowledge_base_id where d.knowledge_base_id = #{base.id} and d.del_flag = 0 and c.del_flag = 0 and d.chunk_status = 'confirmed' and d.upload_status = 'completed' and not exists (select 1 from ${table} v where v.chunk_id = c.id and v.knowledge_base_id = d.knowledge_base_id and v.index_version = #{base.buildingIndexVersion} and v.processing_version = d.processing_version)

select count(*) from ai_knowledge_chunk c join ai_knowledge_document d on d.id = c.document_id and d.knowledge_base_id = c.knowledge_base_id where d.id = #{documentId} and d.knowledge_base_id = #{base.id} and c.del_flag = 0 and d.del_flag = 0 and not exists (select 1 from ${table} v where v.chunk_id = c.id and v.knowledge_base_id = d.knowledge_base_id and v.index_version = #{base.activeIndexVersion} and v.model_connection_id = #{base.activeConnectionId} and v.processing_version = d.processing_version)
mapper.delete: delete from ${table} v where not exists (select 1 from ai_knowledge_base b where b.id = v.knowledge_base_id and b.del_flag = 0) or exists ( select 1 from ai_knowledge_base b where b.id = v.knowledge_base_id and b.del_flag = 0 and b.update_time < current_timestamp - interval '10 minutes' and v.index_version != b.active_index_version and not (b.index_status = 'building' and v.index_version = b.building_index_version) )
mapper.select: select * from ai_knowledge_base where del_flag = 0 and index_status = 'building' and (index_lease_until is null or index_lease_until < current_timestamp) order by index_started_time limit 5
mapper.update: update ai_knowledge_base set index_lease_until = current_timestamp + interval '1 hour' where id = #{id} and building_index_version = #{version} and index_status = 'building' and (index_lease_until is null or index_lease_until < current_timestamp)
